name: Eldritch Invocations
description: You learn fragments of forbidden knowledge called invocations. You know 1 at level 1, 3 at level 2, 5 at level 5, 6 at level 7, 7 at level 9, 8 at level 12, 9 at level 15, and 10 at level 18. Some have prerequisites you must meet, and you can't take the same one twice unless it says so. Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you can replace one invocation with another you qualify for. Pact of the Blade, Pact of the Chain, and Pact of the Tome are chosen as invocations.

name: Pact Magic
description: You cast Warlock spells using Charisma. You know 2 cantrips (3 at level 4, 4 at level 10) and prepare a list of spells that grows as you level. All your Pact Magic slots are the same level, which rises from level 1 to level 5 by Warlock level 9, and you regain them on a Short or Long Rest. You have 1 slot at level 1, 2 at level 2, 3 at level 11, and 4 at level 17. You can use an Arcane Focus as a Spellcasting Focus.

name: Magical Cunning
description: If all your Pact Magic slots are spent, you can perform a 1-minute rite to regain half of your maximum number of slots (rounded up). You can do this once per Long Rest.

name: Warlock Subclass
description: You choose a subclass: Archfey Patron, Celestial Patron, Fiend Patron, or Great Old One Patron. You gain its features at levels 3, 6, 10, and 14.

name: Ability Score Improvement
description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for. You gain this again at levels 8, 12, and 16.

name: Contact Patron
description: You always have Contact Other Plane prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot to contact your patron, and you automatically succeed on the spell's saving throw when you do. You can do this once per Long Rest.

name: Mystic Arcanum
description: Choose one level 6 Warlock spell as your arcanum. You can cast it once without a spell slot, regaining that use on a Long Rest. You gain another arcanum of level 7 at Warlock level 13, level 8 at level 15, and level 9 at level 17. Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you can replace one arcanum spell with another of the same level.

name: Epic Boon
description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for. Boon of Fate is the suggested choice.

name: Eldritch Master
description: When you use Magical Cunning, you regain all your spent Pact Magic slots.

name: Archfey Spells
description: You always have these spells prepared once you reach the listed Warlock level. Level 3: Calm Emotions, Faerie Fire, Misty Step, Phantasmal Force, Sleep. Level 5: Blink, Plant Growth. Level 7: Dominate Beast, Greater Invisibility. Level 9: Dominate Person, Seeming.

name: Steps of the Fey
description:
You can cast Misty Step without a spell slot a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1), regaining those uses on a Long Rest. Whenever you cast the spell, you can add one effect:
Refreshing Step: right after you teleport, you or one creature you can see within 10 feet gains 1d10 Temporary Hit Points.
Taunting Step: creatures within 5 feet of the space you left must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have Disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than you until the start of your next turn.

name: Misty Escape
description:
You can cast Misty Step as a Reaction in response to taking damage. You also gain two more Steps of the Fey effects:
Disappearing Step: you are Invisible until the start of your next turn, or until right after you make an attack roll, deal damage, or cast a spell.
Dreadful Step: creatures within 5 feet of the space you left or the space you arrive in (your choice) must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or take 2d10 Psychic damage.

name: Beguiling Defenses
description: You are immune to the Charmed condition. Also, right after a creature you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can use your Reaction to halve the damage you take and force the attacker to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failure, it takes Psychic damage equal to the damage you take. You can use this Reaction once per Long Rest, or again by spending a Pact Magic slot (no action required).

name: Bewitching Magic
description: Right after you cast an Enchantment or Illusion spell using an action and a spell slot, you can cast Misty Step as part of the same action without spending a spell slot.

name: Celestial Spells
description: You always have these spells prepared once you reach the listed Warlock level. Level 3: Aid, Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt, Lesser Restoration, Light, Sacred Flame. Level 5: Daylight, Revivify. Level 7: Guardian of Faith, Wall of Fire. Level 9: Greater Restoration, Summon Celestial.

name: Healing Light
description: You have a pool of d6s equal to 1 plus your Warlock level, which refills on a Long Rest. As a Bonus Action, you can heal yourself or a creature you can see within 60 feet by spending dice from the pool, up to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) at once. Roll them and restore Hit Points equal to the total.

name: Radiant Soul
description: You have Resistance to Radiant damage. Also, once per turn, when a spell you cast deals Radiant or Fire damage, you can add your Charisma modifier to that spell's damage against one of its targets.

name: Celestial Resilience
description: You gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Warlock level plus your Charisma modifier whenever you use Magical Cunning or finish a Short or Long Rest. At the same time, you can choose up to five creatures you can see to gain Temporary Hit Points equal to half your Warlock level plus your Charisma modifier.

name: Searing Vengeance
description: When you or an ally within 60 feet of you is about to make a Death Saving Throw, you can release radiant energy to save them. The creature regains Hit Points equal to half its Hit Point maximum and can end the Prone condition on itself. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of it takes Radiant damage equal to 2d8 plus your Charisma modifier and is Blinded until the end of the current turn. You can do this once per Long Rest.

name: Dark One's Blessing
description: When you reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Charisma modifier plus your Warlock level (minimum of 1). You gain the same benefit when someone else reduces an enemy within 10 feet of you to 0 Hit Points.

name: Fiend Spells
description: You always have these spells prepared once you reach the listed Warlock level. Level 3: Burning Hands, Command, Scorching Ray, Suggestion. Level 5: Fireball, Stinking Cloud. Level 7: Fire Shield, Wall of Fire. Level 9: Geas, Insect Plague.

name: Dark One's Own Luck
description: When you make an ability check or a saving throw, you can add 1d10 to the roll. You can decide after seeing the roll but before its effects are applied. You have a number of uses equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1), no more than one per roll, and regain them on a Long Rest.

name: Fiendish Resilience
description: Whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest, choose one damage type other than Force. You have Resistance to it until you choose a different one with this feature.

name: Hurl Through Hell
description: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can try to send it through the Lower Planes. It makes a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failure, it vanishes and is Incapacitated until the end of your next turn, when it returns to the space it left or the nearest free space; if it isn't a Fiend, it takes 8d10 Psychic damage. You can do this once per Long Rest, or again by spending a Pact Magic slot (no action required).

name: Awakened Mind
description: As a Bonus Action, choose a creature you can see within 30 feet. You and it can speak telepathically while within a number of miles of each other equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1). To understand each other, you each need to use a language the other knows. The link lasts for a number of minutes equal to your Warlock level and ends early if you use this on a different creature.

name: Great Old One Spells
description: You always have these spells prepared once you reach the listed Warlock level. Level 3: Detect Thoughts, Dissonant Whispers, Phantasmal Force, Tasha's Hideous Laughter. Level 5: Clairvoyance, Hunger of Hadar. Level 7: Confusion, Summon Aberration. Level 9: Modify Memory, Telekinesis.

name: Psychic Spells
description: When you cast a Warlock spell that deals damage, you can change its damage type to Psychic. Also, when you cast a Warlock spell from the Enchantment or Illusion school, you can cast it without Verbal or Somatic components.

name: Clairvoyant Combatant
description: When you form a telepathic link with a creature using Awakened Mind, you can force it to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failure, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls against you, and you have Advantage on attack rolls against it, for as long as the link lasts. You can do this once per Short or Long Rest, or again by spending a Pact Magic slot (no action required).

name: Eldritch Hex
description: You always have Hex prepared. When you cast it and choose an ability, the target also has Disadvantage on saving throws using that ability for the spell's duration.

name: Thought Shield
description: Your thoughts can't be read by telepathy or other means unless you allow it. You have Resistance to Psychic damage, and whenever a creature deals Psychic damage to you, it takes the same amount of damage that you take.

name: Create Thrall
description: When you cast Summon Aberration, you can make it need no Concentration; if you do, it lasts 1 minute for that casting, and the Aberration appears with Temporary Hit Points equal to your Warlock level plus your Charisma modifier. Also, the first time each turn the Aberration hits a creature under your Hex, it deals extra Psychic damage equal to that spell's bonus damage.
